text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', 'SimSun', 'SimHei', 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: 总线型：一条干线挂所有从站

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', 'SimSun', 'SimHei', 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: 终端电阻两端各一，任一从站故障不影响其余站点

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', 'SimSun', 'SimHei', 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: 星型：交换机居中，链路独享

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', 'SimSun', 'SimHei', 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: 单点故障隔离好，但排队延迟随负载上升

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', 'SimSun', 'SimHei', 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: 环型：一帧穿过所有从站

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', 'SimSun', 'SimHei', 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: 返回帧由从站边转发边写入，主站一次收发完成全部交换
